summary: A snapshot taken in October 2008 by the IRTF Internet Congestion Control Research Group, surveying congestion control topics covered across the RFC series. It does not change any specification and is meant as a reference and a starting point for noting gaps in IETF standards. It is informational.

eli5.summary: It is a guidebook listing everything written down so far about how to stop roads from jamming up when too many cars arrive at once.
